findings: This is not a statutory FY results RNS or annual report; it is a product/regulatory announcement of US FDA 510(k) clearance for the CATALYSTEM Primary Hip System (source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/SN.L/20260904T181157Z/sources/filings/bodies/85fc7018d796b25f.txt).

Device scope: primary total hip arthroplasty stem for evolving primary hip surgery needs, including increased anterior-approach adoption and Ambulatory Surgery Centre (ASC) use; shorter, proximally filling triple-taper stem with uniform proximal loading and reduced distal geometry, suitable for anterior approach but stated as suitable for all approaches (source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/SN.L/20260904T181157Z/sources/filings/bodies/85fc7018d796b25f.txt).

US clearance: Smith+Nephew received 510(k) clearance from the United States Food and Drug Administration for CATALYSTEM Primary Hip System; announcement framed as received “today” with no explicit calendar date in the body (source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/SN.L/20260904T181157Z/sources/filings/bodies/85fc7018d796b25f.txt).

Commercial positioning: complements existing hip portfolio; builds on POLAR3 clinical heritage; integrates with proprietary OXINIUM Technology and CORI Surgical System robotics platform; single modular tray tailored to surgical approach for ASC efficiencies (shelf space, sterilisation costs) (source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/SN.L/20260904T181157Z/sources/filings/bodies/85fc7018d796b25f.txt).

ACCUBROACH Technology (proprietary, patent-pending) claims reproducibility between broach and implant for predictable stem seating (source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/SN.L/20260904T181157Z/sources/filings/bodies/85fc7018d796b25f.txt).

Market/segment language (no Smith+Nephew revenue impact stated): segment described as rapidly growing at compound annual growth rate >10%, fitting diverse patient anatomies; shift toward shorter proximally filling stems for direct anterior approach (source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/SN.L/20260904T181157Z/sources/filings/bodies/85fc7018d796b25f.txt).

No revenue guidance, launch phasing, sales targets, or Orthopaedics division performance figures appear in this release (source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/SN.L/20260904T181157Z/sources/filings/bodies/85fc7018d796b25f.txt).

No US knee product claims; content is hip-only (CATALYSTEM Primary Hip System) (source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/SN.L/20260904T181157Z/sources/filings/bodies/85fc7018d796b25f.txt).

Risk language is generic boilerplate forward-looking statements (revenue growth, trading margins, market trends, pipeline, competition, regulatory/reimbursement, supply chain, litigation, FX, etc.); no product-specific adverse events or competitive naming (source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/SN.L/20260904T181157Z/sources/filings/bodies/85fc7018d796b25f.txt).

Availability caveat: products may not be available in all markets due to regulatory and/or medical practices; readers directed to Smith+Nephew representative for local availability (source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/SN.L/20260904T181157Z/sources/filings/bodies/85fc7018d796b25f.txt).
